fact_text: Bilateral loans from partner countries often carry higher interest than other debt, and the lender can recall them suddenly, which creates an abrupt repayment problem for the borrower.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Issuing international sovereign bonds lets a country reduce its reliance on bilateral lenders, which lowers rollover risk and the overall cost of financing, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A sovereign credit rating upgrade is read as rising investor confidence in the country, which tends to bring bond investors when the government issues debt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refinery margins on diesel in Pakistan are negotiated with the government, which can lower them to ease pump prices; refiners argue the margin is needed to fund their upgrade programmes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When international product prices and refining margins spike during a Gulf conflict, local refinery margins on diesel rise with them, pushing up domestic diesel prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refinery share prices tend to fall on reports that the government will cap diesel margins, because a margin cut comes straight out of refiners' earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Regional conflict disrupts shipping lanes, raising freight rates through higher insurance and fuel costs and reducing vessel availability, which squeezes exporters' margins on the affected routes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The petroleum development levy is a government tax collected on petrol and diesel, and the government can change it to influence pump prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The IMF wants one uniform tax regime across all sectors and the plan is to wind down special economic zones and export processing zones by 2035; a Senate committee urged renegotiation to keep them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Special economic zones and export processing zones exist to promote chosen sectors by cutting or removing their taxes, so they conflict with a single uniform national tax regime.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cash dividends paid by PSX-listed companies dipped to about PKR 37 billion in FY2020, the COVID year, and then rose in each of the five years after.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cash dividends paid by PSX-listed companies crossed PKR 1 trillion in FY2026 for the first time, about 19% above the roughly PKR 849 billion paid in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSX-listed companies' dividends grew at a compound rate of about 11.12% a year, from roughly PKR 352 billion in FY2016 to the FY2026 level.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Commercial banks paid about PKR 406 billion of dividends in FY2026, roughly 30.5% more than the prior year and about 40% of all dividends paid by PSX-listed companies.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC's FY2026 consolidated net profit was about PKR 22 billion, up from about PKR 19 billion in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC's earnings per share rose to about PKR 56.35 in FY2026 from PKR 39.5 in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC announced a PKR 6 per share dividend alongside its FY2026 results.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Naya Nazimabad REIT is a closed-end, Shariah-compliant development REIT whose assets are three real estate portfolios in Karachi and Lahore.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The combined value of the REIT's three portfolios was about PKR 20.46 billion as of April 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Renewed US-Iran military confrontation pushes global oil prices up and pulls the PSX lower over the following sessions; the analyst expects such moves to be temporary.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects Middle East flare-ups to fade after a ceasefire, with oil prices and Pakistani stocks then recovering, a pattern the analyst says has repeated for some time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Everything You Need to Know This Week: Economy, Defense & Stock Market | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)
